residencyRequirements.description: Either party must be domiciled in Hong Kong OR have been habitually resident in Hong Kong for a continuous period of at least 3 years immediately before the presentation of the petition (Matrimonial Causes Ordinance, s.3).

waitingPeriod.description: No mandatory waiting period after filing. However, a petition cannot be presented within the first year of marriage (s.12 MCO — the 1-year bar). After Decree Nisi, a minimum of 6 weeks must pass before applying for Decree Absolute.

oneYearBar.description: No petition for divorce shall be presented before the expiration of 1 year from the date of the marriage (s.12 MCO). The court may grant leave in exceptional circumstances of hardship or depravity.

noFault.name: 1-Year Separation with Consent
noFault.description: The parties have lived apart for a continuous period of at least 1 year immediately before presentation of the petition, and the Respondent consents to the divorce.

noFault.name: 2-Year Separation without Consent
noFault.description: The parties have lived apart for a continuous period of at least 2 years immediately before presentation of the petition (no consent of Respondent required).

noFault.name: Joint Application by Mutual Agreement
noFault.description: Both parties jointly apply for divorce by mutual agreement under s.11B. Both parties must prove that they have lived apart for at least 1 year immediately preceding the application, OR that at least 1 year prior to the application both signed a written notice (Form 2E) of their intention to apply and it was not withdrawn.

fault.name: Adultery
fault.description: The Respondent has committed adultery and the Petitioner finds it intolerable to live with the Respondent.

fault.name: Unreasonable Behaviour
fault.description: The Respondent has behaved in such a way that the Petitioner cannot reasonably be expected to live with the Respondent.

fault.name: Desertion for 1 Year
fault.description: The Respondent has deserted the Petitioner for a continuous period of at least 1 year immediately before the presentation of the petition.

terminology.maritalProperty: Matrimonial Property (Matrimonial Proceedings and Property Ordinance, Cap 192, s.7)

basic.description: Required if there are children of the family under 18

basic.description: Respondent's acknowledgment of receipt of the petition

filingFees.notes: HKD $630 for cases on the special procedure list (uncontested). HKD $1,045 for cases on the defended list (contested). Fee waiver available for financially eligible applicants.

childSupportGuidelines.guidelines: No statutory formula — court exercises discretion under Guardianship of Minors Ordinance (Cap 13) and Matrimonial Proceedings and Property Ordinance (Cap 192)
childSupportGuidelines.notes: The court considers the needs of the child, the income and financial resources of each parent, any physical or mental disability of the child, and the manner in which the child is being or is expected to be educated.

spousalSupportGuidelines.guidelines: Matrimonial Proceedings and Property Ordinance (Cap 192), ss.3-4 and s.7
spousalSupportGuidelines.notes: The court considers income, earning capacity, financial needs, standard of living during the marriage, age, duration of marriage, disabilities, contributions to the welfare of the family, and conduct.

decreeProcess.step1: Decree Nisi — provisional order dissolving the marriage
decreeProcess.step3: Decree Absolute — final order making the divorce effective
decreeProcess.description: The Petitioner (or Respondent after an additional 3 months) may apply for the Decree Nisi to be made Absolute not earlier than 6 weeks after it is pronounced.

effectiveDateRule: The marriage is dissolved on the date the Decree Absolute is granted. There is a mandatory 6-week interval between Decree Nisi and Decree Absolute.
certificateNote: A Certificate of Decree Absolute may be obtained from the Family Court Registry after the Decree Absolute is granted.
